content.text: This isn't a flaky test — the two failures are real bugs in `dispatch_queue_batch`/`failed_dispatch`: they only check `future.cancelled()` before calling `set_result`/`set_exception`, but not `future.done()`, so if a future is already resolved externally, `set_exception`/`set_result` raises `InvalidStateError`, which escapes as an unhandled task exception. Skipping these tests would hide a real race condition rather than fix it. The correct fix is a one-line guard change in two spots, which is just as fast.

content.text: Green — all 24 tests pass. Root cause: `dispatch_queue_batch` and `failed_dispatch` only guarded against `future.cancelled()` before calling `set_result`/`set_exception`, so a future already resolved externally (or by a prior branch) would hit `InvalidStateError`. Changed both guards to `future.done()` in `aiodataloader/__init__.py`, which is the actual bug the tests were catching — no tests were deleted or skipped.
